When you learn a new language, the basics are very important; that’s why we will go at your own pace to make sure you’ve understood everything before moving on. 

I am here to help you and I am extremely patient so don’t be shy :)

You'll get to learn more about English-speaking countries, people, culture, customs, daily topics, useful vocabulary, etc. The book is divided into units -topics. By joining this course, you'll be able to master the different sounds, get the right intonation and a clearer diction, and be more confident in yourself when speaking French!

We will work together using different proven techniques -focusing on sounds, intonations, rhythm, diction, breathing, etc- to reduce your native accent and make you sound more like a French speaker!

teacher_info.introduction: When I was 5 years old I traveled to Africa and became fascinated by all the different languages and dialects from all over that wonderful continent. My polyglot life at home with my French mother, my Portuguese father and a black and white television that showed, every evening, mostly American and British movies in the original version. And of course I shouldn't forget to mention my dear Belgian grandmother from Flanders who lived through the second world war learning German as perfectly as it was possible. My journey through Western Europe started few months after my 18th year birthday, where I got to know Spain, France, Germany and Denmark. It was in Denmark that I got my Danish language certificate and the chance to study Portuguese language and literature at Aarhus University as well as South American Studies. After 11 years of working, studying and teaching I decided to move to Rome (Italy) where I learned Italian at an advanced level. It was in Lima (Peru) that I was offered the opportunity to work as a Six Language Coordinator for Headway College, selecting teachers and preparing them to teach at this internationally respected institute. In 2007 I started work intensely at home as a private teacher and I have successfully continued doing so since then. My students are from all ages (from 5 to 70 years old) and all levels (from Beginners, Intermediate, Advanced and Test Preparation). My Specialty is to be able to teach the third language with your second language which is much more effective than to do it with your mother tongue. I am a lucky man because I do what I love and I have the privilege of helping others communicate in totally new situations and worlds. In order not to forget what it is like to learn a new language, I am actually learning German at 52% and Hebrew at 5% . Thank you for reading this introduction and I hope to see you soon.

pro_course_detail.description:
This course is intended to neutralize your foreign accent and help you understand the French as well as speak like a French native speaker as much as possible. Anybody can do this. It's all about understanding how your mouth works, learning how to tune your ear and focus on the details that make native speakers speak the way they do!
You will also learn about French phonology and master things like the "liaison" (linking), the "enchaînement" (the way words flow into each other), vowel lengthening and intonation among many other things!

You will probably get more out of this course if you already know a tiny wee bit of French. But the sooner the start, the better. It's hard to let go of bad habits; thus, it is better to start as soon as possible on your French journey. But it's never too late either!
